evidence.acceptance_limitation: exact project canonical_parcel_id binding to HMLR Title_No/Poly_ID (INSPIRE_ID) identifiers
evidence.dataset: HM Land Registry National Polygon dataset technical specification

field_evidence.identifier_relationship: Every index polygon has Poly_ID; relationship between registered title and polygon(s) is managed through Title_No.
field_evidence.inspire_relationship: INSPIRE Index Polygons are a subset of National Polygon Dataset; INSPIRE_ID is the same identifier family as published polygon identifier per HMLR lookup specification.
field_evidence.geometry: Shape is mandatory and index polygon geometry is a single area.
field_evidence.limitation: Public specification establishes HMLR identifier relationships but does not expose this project's canonical_parcel_id inventory/mapping.

evidence.licence: official HMLR technical specification; dataset access terms apply
